notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

We've released a new patch today, here's the changelog:

[u]Patch 1.0.3[/u]
(2014-02-26)
- Add a windowed mode with the launch option -window or -windowed
- Add a leaderboard anti-cheat system

[u]Patch 1.0.2[/u]
(2013-11-07)
- Fix a stat reset in local co-op mode for the player 2.

[u]Patch 1.0.1[/u]
(2013-11-06)
- Fix a disconnection in the lobby when you finish a chapter.

Enjoy the game. 
Focus Home Interactive

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1. and beta patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

[u][b]Patch 1.0.1[/b][/u]
We've fixed an issue in the multiplayer lobby.
When you finish a chapter with your friend in online mode, you're now not disconnected from the lobby and you can continue the next chapters with your friends without re-creating a lobby everytime.

[u][b]Beta patch 1.0.2[/b][/u]
We've also prepared a beta patch 1.0.2 that fixes a stat reset in local co-op mode for the player 2.
For people who experienced this issue, we'd like they confirm that the fix works fine before to release it for everyone. So please let us know if it's good.

To get the beta patch 1.0.2, please follow the below steps:

1 - Right-click on Final Exam in your Steam library and select Properties.
2 - Go to the Betas tab.
3 - In the drop-down menu, select beta_patch if you don't have it, you may need to restart your Steam client.
4- Quit the properties panel and Steam will automatically update the game with the beta patch.

Enjoy the game.
Thierry

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Final Exam
notes.content:
Final Exam is Now Available on Steam!

Jump into the frenzied action and the whacky humor of a pure 2.5D side-scroller!

While they were going to their old high school for what was supposed to be the party of their life, four long-time friends end up in a ghost town full of monstrous creatures.

Alone or in cooperative mode (4 players online and 2 in local play), survive hordes of monsters ready to skin you alive and achieve unique and varied objectives throughout huge and non-linear levels. Choose your character, knock out high-scores and thoroughly explore each stage to gain experience and reach higher levels. Find new weapons, improve your skills, unlock new special moves and devastating powers… and achieve increasingly impressive combos to outdo your friends' high-scores.
